title: Scythe of Myrkul
summary: Apostle of Myrkul’s unique scythe, unavailable to ordinary wielders.

fields.Weapon profile: 2d12 Slashing plus Strength. Martial two-handed glaive. Only the Apostle of Myrkul can wield it.
fields.Reaper’s Scythe: Action once per turn. Sweeps a 120° arc in a 17 ft cone for 2d12 + Strength Slashing and 3d6 Necrotic. DC 18 Strength save. The action page specifies 4 m (13 ft) knockback, while the item lists 10 ft.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
